column1: # oxidestack/docx-to-pdf against moalhaddar/docx-to-pdf and gotenberg/gotenberg 8.38.1 on one vCPU and one pool slot
# each: CPU, disk, memory, latency and throughput. Quick plan step 1's cell c1-p1: the typical workload, a closed load
# of 3 clients, 16 GiB, /tmp on the VM disk, tracing off, 52 conversions. gotenberg as shipped restarts LibreOffice
# every 10 conversions; g-norestart turns that off (LIBREOFFICE_RESTART_AFTER=0), as oxidestack/docx-to-pdf recycles
# only on its own limits. moalhaddar/docx-to-pdf as bench.py runs it (oracle.env's image). Four services in the
# comparison, ours on arm64 and on amd64, moalhaddar/docx-to-pdf and gotenberg: amd64 natively, arm64 only for ours and
# gotenberg, since moalhaddar/docx-to-pdf is amd64 only.
